name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's journey in motorsport started early, fueled by his father's passion for rally racing. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from the Warsaw University of Technology, specializing in vehicle dynamics. His career began at a small racing team in Poland, where he quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a keen eye for detail and an ability to optimize car performance under pressure.

He joined Tickford Racing three years ago as a senior engineer, and his innovative solutions and meticulous approach to problem-solving quickly made him an invaluable asset. Krzysztof believes in fostering a collaborative environment, empowering his team to think creatively and challenge conventional approaches. His distinctive focus on data analysis and predictive modeling sets him apart, allowing him to anticipate and mitigate potential issues before they arise. His steady hand and dedication to continuous improvement led to his promotion to technical director.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a lean build and a focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every morning with a strong cup of black coffee.
